record.question: Most radiosensitive period of pregnancy:
record.explanation: Answer C: first trimester. Early pregnancy, particularly organogenesis in the first trimester, is sensitive to developmental malformations after sufficient radiation dose. Sensitivity depends on gestational stage and the endpoint: CNS development has a later sensitive window. Among these broad trimester choices, first trimester is the intended general developmental-risk answer; this is not a claim that every radiation effect peaks then. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html.
